stem: How do the people in paragraphs 2 and 3 of the article “More Than Air” treat nature DIFFERENTLY than the characters in paragraphs 9 through 14 of the story A Forest Full of Stars?

options.label: A
options.text: The villagers create tools from nature.

options.label: B
options.text: The artists spend time looking at nature.

options.label: C
options.text: The villagers ask questions about nature.

options.label: D
options.text: The artists notice animals in nature.
